description: This file defines the Template class within the org.openmrs.notification package, representing notification templates with properties like name, subject, recipients, sender, content, and associated metadata. It includes basic getters and setters, as well as annotations for database auditing purposes.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A Java class representing a notification template, extending BaseOpenmrsObject, with properties for the template's identification, content, recipients, sender, subject, and associated metadata.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the template.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the template.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the template.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template.

methods.name: setRecipients
methods.description: Sets the recipients of the notification.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Returns the recipients of the notification.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender of the notification.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the sender of the notification.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the email or notification subject.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email or notification subject.

methods.name: setOrdinal
methods.description: Sets the ordinal value for ordering templates.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data map holding additional template data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data map associated with the template.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the template.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the template.
